Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the purchase of certain lands by state agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to purchase of land by state agencies; and addinga new section to chapter 79.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No state agency may purchase a privately owned parcel of landin excess of five contiguous acres in any county in which public land,federal land, and tribal land together constitute more than seventypercent of the total area of the county, except under the provisions ofsubsection (2) of this section. (2) An agency may purchase more than five contiguous acres underthe provisions of this section if: (a) The legislature takes specificaction directing the agency to make the purchase; (b) the appropriatecounty legislative authority or authorities consent to the transaction;and (c) the transaction is funded by other than state dollars. (3) When land is purchased by a state agency, the agency must posta bond or otherwise financially guarantee that the land will be managedfor the control of noxious weeds and the maintenance of forest health. p. 1 SB 5020The bond or financial guarantee is to be determined by the appropriatecounty legislative authority and must be based upon the size of theparcel.
